title: Battle Unit Keep (live party member / unit sheet) — memory-only

container.notes: MEMORY-ONLY (runtime). No game file. Party members: [0x02EBF190] + 0x08 + id*0x1C8 (id 0-39, 40 records, inside the live Battle block of the save image, see save-game). Any unit: Battle Unit Work +0x698 -> keep, +0x6A0 -> keep plus. Game helper 0x00320A40(id) returns a party keep. Steam 1.0.4.0 addresses.

records.name: battleUnitKeep
records.where: Party members: [0x02EBF190] + 0x08 + partyMemberId*0x1C8 (40 records, ids 0-39, inside the live Battle block of the save data; game helper 0x00320A40 returns the same pointer for an id). Any unit (party or foe): Battle Unit Work +0x698 holds a pointer to its keep.
records.count: 40 for party members (PartyMemberList 0-39); foes: one per spawned unit

roundTrip: Memory-only: never write this record into a game file; it is rebuilt from battlepack/ARD data and from the save.
Edit fields in place; do not move or resize the party array (stride 0x1C8, 40 entries).
Write the two union views consistently: for party members (type 0) only use the default* view.
